incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: AUTH_TOKEN_SIGNING_ERRORS (P1) - automatic page to oncall
PagerDuty: Notified oncall Priya (auth-sre) and escalation policy "auth-escalation"
Priya: ack. I'm taking incident command. Quick status please.
Devon: we're seeing a sharp increase in 401s across the hosted API. Validation logs show both `kid not found` and `alg mismatch` errors.
Devon: sample from prod-auth logs:
`````
ERROR verify.go:142: jwt validation failed: alg="RS256" expected="RS512" kid="k_live_77"; signature verification failed
`````
Maya: CS queue: multiple paying customers reporting immediate token rejects on token refresh. Marking high impact.
Oliver: any recent deploys to token-issuer or key-service?
deploy-bot: deployment record: token-issuer v2.3.1 deployed at 2026-03-20T03:12Z; config change: SIGNING_ALG=RS512
Devon: token-issuer started issuing RS512-signed tokens (kid=k_live_77). Key-service JWKS currently lists RS256 keys only. So validators reject based on alg or missing public key type.
Priya: two mitigation options: rollback token-issuer signing alg to RS256, or publish RS512 public key into JWKS (needs KMS/HSM key material). Which is fastest?
Devon: rollback of token-issuer to RS256 is fastest and lowest risk — will stop issuing new RS512 tokens. But some recently issued tokens may still be in circulation until expiry; we'll also refresh JWKS and purge caches.
Priya: proceed with rollback and JWKS refresh. Also prepare customer message template.
Devon: running rollback now:
`````
kubectl -n authset set env deploy/token-issuer SIGNING_ALG=RS256
kubectl -n authset rollout restart deploy/token-issuer
`````
Devon: rollout started. Also hitting key-service admin refresh endpoint to ensure JWKS contains any freshly published keys.
Devon: JWKS refresh command:
`````
curl -s -X POST https://key-service.internal/admin/refresh-jwks -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
`````
Devon: key-service responded: "refreshed 2 entries". However, note: JWKS is fronted by CDN with 60s TTL — edge caches may still serve old JSWKS for a minute or two. Purging CDN now.
Devon: CDN purge command executed:
`````
platform-tools purge-cache --host keys.redwood.public --path /prod/.well-known/jwks.json
`````
Devon: purge acknowledged; edge nodes will fetch fresh JWKS within 30-90s.
Maya: status page update queued: "We are investigating authentication failures causing 401s for API requests. Engineers have deployed a rollback and are refreshing key caches. Updates in 10 minutes."
Priya: monitoring metrics: https://metrics.internal/redwood/auth/verify_errors (watching eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1)
Priya: eu-west-1 error rate dropping; ap-southeast-1 still showing elevated errors due to cache/CDN lag.
Oliver: can we accelerate edge refresh in troubled regions? Platform confirmed purge propagated to most POPs, but some ISP caches may still hold old content.
Devon: starting a targeted restart of auth-validator pods in ap-southeast to force immediate JWKS refetch on startup.
Devon: command:
`````
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/auth-validator --selector=region=ap-southeast
`````
SupportBot: outbound customer messages sent using template "auth-401-investigating"; tickets appended for high-touch accounts.
Maya: CS is on calls with 4 customers; offering short-term workarounds (token refresh retries, extended timeouts).
Priya: running end-to-end smoke tests for token issue + validation across regions.
Devon: issuance now RS256 globally; validation probes returning 200. Running broader API smoke tests.
Priya: ap-southeast error curve now trending down to baseline. Rolling checks for full recovery.
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigation applied (rollback + JWKS refresh). PagerDuty incident acknowledged and in monitoring.
Priya: assigning postmortem to Devon, RCA coordination to Saira. We need deploy guardrails to prevent alg mismatches.
Saira: action items captured:
- (Platform) implement deploy-time check: ensure token-issuer SIGNING_ALG matches key-service JWKS algs before promote
- (Devon) add automated canary that validates signing alg and presence of kid immediately post-deploy
- (SRE) alert when JWKS has zero keys or when algs diverge between issuer and JWKS
- (CS) update customer comms templates for auth incidents and escalation flow
Oliver: handoff: Priya will remain IC for monitoring window; handoff to me in 10 minutes for post-incident coordination.
Priya: handing off IC -> Oliver now. :white_check_mark:
Maya: saving incident artifacts and support logs: https://confluence.internal/redwood/incidents/1842005678
Priya: closing pager; switching to monitoring channel for 60m. Will mark resolved after 60 minutes of stable metrics.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident marked resolved by Oliver at 2026-03-20T03:59:38Z. Postmortem requested.
